CustomField.description: The reviewer's decision on a row in Needs Review. Accept: re-match the row using the Firm and Fund Overrides (filled from Claude's suggestion when left blank); on a roster row, apply it (create the advisor, code and assignment and resolve matching follow-ups). Reject: the row is not loaded. Recorded with who decided and when.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Accept to apply the suggestion or your overrides, or Reject to exclude the row.
CustomField.label: Reviewer Decision
